versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00312 The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> Services from the Rte_COMCbkTpRxIndication callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPduDirec- tion parameter set to COM_RECEIVE [SWS_COM_00921] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].

The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication Ser- vices from the Rte_LdComCbkTpRxIndication callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has its LdComIP- duDirection parameter set to LDCOM_RECEIVE [SWS_LDCOM_00049] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].

The RTE shall call all Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication Ser- vices from the Rte_LdComCbkTpRxIndication callback for Communication Graphs where • The communication graph references an LdComIPdu which has its LdComIP- duDirection parameter set to LDCOM_RECEIVE [SWS_LDCOM_00049] AND • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794].
